```suggestion
				Log.w(TAG, "SecurityException: VIBRATE permission not found. Make sure it is enabled in the export preset.")
```

Enabling in the export preset adds the permission to manifest during export.

I've changed the text. And what about the `Godot Android library`? 
Do users have to edit the manifest file themselves?

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/platform/android/android_library.html

> I've changed the text. And what about the `Godot Android library`? Do users have to edit the manifest file themselves?
> 
> https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/platform/android/android_library.html

Good point, I think we should keep the language about checking that it's declared in the manifest.

In the documentation, I also found `Godot Android plugins`. 
Should I then output the error message more generally in 2 lines?


```kotlin
Log.w(TAG, "SecurityException: VIBRATE permission not found. Make sure it is enabled in the export preset.")
Log.w(TAG, "If using a custom Android library (e.g. Godot plugin), declare it in the AndroidManifest.xml.")
```

How about this then?
```
Log.w(TAG, "SecurityException: VIBRATE permission not found. Make sure it is declared in the manifest or enabled in the export preset.")
```

> In the documentation, I also found `Godot Android plugins`. Should I then output the error message more generally in 2 lines?

> Log.w(TAG, "SecurityException: VIBRATE permission not found. Make sure it is enabled in the export preset.")

This also seems good.
